basic.label: Home
basic.note: Your family eats, rests and plays at home.

basic.label: School
basic.note: Children learn and play together at school.

basic.label: Park
basic.note: The park has room to run and play.

basic.label: Library
basic.note: You borrow books from the library and bring them back.

basic.label: Store
basic.note: You pay for the things you take from the store.

basic.label: Church
basic.note: We gather at church to worship God.

advanced.label: Fire station
advanced.note: Firefighters keep their trucks ready at the fire station.

advanced.label: Post office
advanced.note: Letters leave the post office on their way to other homes.

advanced.label: Hospital
advanced.note: Doctors and nurses care for sick and hurt people at the hospital.

advanced.label: Bakery
advanced.note: Bakers make bread in the bakery.

advanced.label: Bus stop
advanced.note: You wait beside your grown-up at the bus stop.

advanced.label: Crosswalk
advanced.note: You cross with your grown-up at the crosswalk after checking traffic.

advanced.label: Sidewalk
advanced.note: The sidewalk keeps walkers beside the road.

advanced.label: Playground
advanced.note: You take turns on the playground equipment.
